name: Bárboles (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue pall reversed from the hoist corners to the fly, charged with grapes at the hoist and ears of wheat and grass at the upper and lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Bárboles; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: pall reversed from the hoist corners to the centre of the fly
bunch of grapes at the hoist
ear of wheat at the upper fly and a plant at the lower fly
